description: Purchase a managed number. Requires explicit user approval (confirm=true) and a stable idempotency_key. May incur recurring charges; regulatory or billing setup may require Console.

agent_id.description: Optional agent to route inbound calls to.

compliance_case_id.description: Required for Australian ordering when the selected account/network requires regulatory approval. Select this project's approved new-number compliance application. Regulatory identifiers are resolved server-side; raw identifiers are never accepted.

country.description: The market returned by inventory. Pass CA for a Canadian number because US and Canada share +1.

inventory_reference.description: Pass the reference returned by inventory when present. Refresh inventory if the offer changed.

max_monthly_cost_cents.description: Required Australian order price ceiling in USD cents, taken from displayed inventory. An increased tariff above this ceiling is rejected before reserving or spending. Saved orders retain their original approved price.

phone_number.description: A US, Canada, India, or Australia number (E.164) from the available-numbers search.

project_id.description: Defaults to the authenticated live project. If supplied, it must match that project.

provisioning_mode.description: Use `adopt_preowned` only for a number already ordered through assisted provisioning. It never buys a number.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user authorizes this exact purchase or destination.

idempotency_key.description: Required safe retry key. Reusing the key with an identical body preserves the saved order outcome (201 confirmed number, 202 pending/unknown US, Canadian or Australian order, or 200 definitively failed number order) without a second purchase. A different body returns 409 `idempotency_conflict`.
